bullets: Codebuff paid services will close on December 1, 2026, and new checkouts and purchases are now disabled.
GPT-6.2 coding helpers are now available in the desktop cloud model list.
The desktop model picker now supports a manual option to list all available models.
Community feed access is limited to members who posted sites, unless an admin enables it.
Community post owners can now edit their posts and manage custom thumbnail images.
Community posts can be marked as removed, a status visible only to admins.
Account-wide notification settings now include mobile push and desktop alert controls.
Cloud history now tracks permanently deleted projects separately from archived ones.
